fit: restrictive fried chicken and pasta diet, scurvy and fatigue in a clinical case
assessment: The case reports low vitamin C in a highly restricted diet and symptom resolution after repletion. A different preparation and the absence of a comparator, isolated chicken exposure or Parkinson disease leave the target effect unresolved.

fit: cold-pressed pepper oil in rat memory and uncertain comparator provenance
assessment: Maze and avoidance memory effects are reported. The earlier Bombax paper has matching comparator percentages and is cited in figures, leaving comparison independence unclear. No sustained-attention outcome or cracked culinary pepper comparison.

fit: four botanicals with honey and memory after experimental hypothyroidism
assessment: Author abstract reports better spatial and avoidance memory in treated rats. Details and exact contrasts remain unavailable. It does not isolate the pepper, verify the preparation or measure attention in Parkinson disease.
